includes: Your trip includes pristine swimming holes, gorgeous sandy beaches, and exhilarating rapids.
We provide a delicious organic deli style lunch with turkey, farm fresh veggies, and homemade dessert on this trip.
Many people like to wear a ball cap, which can be worn under the helmets we provide, and sunglasses.
They provided a fun, safe trip along the river, delicious fresh food, and were responsive to any questions or needs before, during and after the trip.
We will have camping provided for the duration of the class, and the kids can camp there with a parent or other responsible adult.
All food, drinks, transportation, rafting and camping gear, and experienced river guides included on overnight trips

blurb: Six Rivers Rafting offers guided whitewater rafting and inflatable kayak trips on the Trinity, Klamath, Salmon, Smith, and Eel Rivers in Northern California. Trips range from half-day to multi-day adventures, including scenic and challenging class II to V rapids. All trips include gear, guides, meals on multi-day trips, and focus on safety and environmental stewardship.
